title.zh: 美伊和平协议压制油价，缓解通胀担忧
title.en: U.S.-Iran Peace Deal Weighs on Oil Prices, Eases Inflation Fears

summary.en: US stocks edge higher in premarket with futures mixed as focus shifts to Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's first policy decision on June 17, while the U.S.-Iran peace deal continues weighing on oil prices. SpaceX extends its post-IPO rally above 9%, memory chip makers surge ahead of AI data center demand, and Tesla climbs alongside lower crude.
summary.zh: 美股盘前小幅走高，三大指数期货方向不一，市场焦点转向美联储新任主席沃什将在 6 月 17 日公布的首次政策决定。美伊和平协议持续压制油价，SpaceX 股价延续上市后涨势，涨幅超过 9%，存储芯片厂商受益于 AI 数据中心需求上涨，特斯拉随原油下跌而反弹。

title.zh: 初步美伊协议降低油价风险溢价，推动普涨行情
title.en: Preliminary U.S.-Iran Deal Reduces Oil Risk Premium, Fuels Broad Rally

summary.en: U.S. futures surged on a preliminary U.S.-Iran agreement easing geopolitical oil worries ahead of the Fed's June 16-17 meeting; energy-sensitive stocks rallied while AI chip leaders posted solid gains with SpaceX IPO at $2T valuation extending premarket strength.
summary.zh: 初步美伊协议缓解了原油供应忧虑，推动美股期货在美联储 6 月 16 至 17 日会议前大涨。对能源价格敏感的股票反弹，AI 芯片龙头上涨。SpaceX 上市估值约 2 万亿美元，上市后股价延续强势。

title.zh: 美伊和平协议临近：特朗普表示"即将签署"
title.en: U.S.-Iran Peace Deal Nears: Trump Signals 'Soon' on Agreement

summary.en: U.S. futures rise as investors digest President Trump's peace deal signal with Iran and await SpaceX IPO debut; oil prices fall while gold surges on geopolitical risk-off, creating mixed sentiment ahead of open.
summary.zh: 美国期指上扬的背景下，投资者关注特朗普总统关于与伊朗签署和平协议的信号以及等待 SpaceX 的首次公开募股（IPO）表现；油价下跌而黄金在避险情绪推动下上涨，盘前呈现多空交织格局。

title.zh: 美伊冲突升级推动油价飙升和市场波动
title.en: Iran-US Escalation Drives Oil Surge and Market Volatility

summary.en: May U.S. consumer prices rose 4.2% year over year, the largest increase since April 2023. Escalating U.S.-Iran tensions pushed oil higher, and semiconductor stocks came under pressure.
summary.zh: 美国 5 月 CPI 同比上涨 4.2%，为 2023 年 4 月以来最大同比涨幅。美伊紧张局势升级推升油价，半导体股票承压。

title.zh: 通胀数据日考验：5 月通胀数据超预期市场在美联储政策会议前抛售
title.en: CPI Day Reckoning: May Inflation Data Exceeds Expectations as Markets Sell Off Ahead of Fed Policy Discussion

summary.en: US stock futures decline as markets digest elevated May CPI data while Middle East tensions between US and Iran escalate, sending oil prices higher despite peace deal signals. Tech sector under pressure amid inflation concerns that reignite Fed rate repricing expectations; gold trades mixed as real yields fluctuate and geopolitical risk premium weighs on safe haven appeal.
summary.zh: 美国股指期货下跌，市场消化高企的 5 月 CPI 数据同时美伊紧张局势升级推升油价。通胀担忧使市场重新评估美联储利率路径，科技股承压。实际收益率波动和地缘风险溢价影响避险需求，黄金走势分化。

title.zh: 强劲的五月份非农就业数据推高美联储加息概率，显示劳动力市场韧性
title.en: Strong May Nonfarm Payrolls Push Fed Rate Hike Probabilities Higher Amid Job Market Resilience

summary.en: US markets reopened on a mixed note following Friday's selloff, with S&P and Nasdaq futures rallying while Dow slips as investors digest strong nonfarm payrolls (172K vs 85K expected) that boost Fed rate hike probabilities. Middle East tensions between Israel and Iran have reignited oil price concerns despite peace deal signals, creating geopolitical risk premiums in energy markets while gold trades under pressure below $4,300.
summary.zh: 美国股市在周五大幅抛售后的重开表现分化，标普和纳斯达克期货上涨而道琼斯指数下滑，投资者正在消化强劲的非农就业数据（172K 远超预期的 85K），推高美联储加息概率。中东以色列与伊朗之间的紧张局势重新引发油价担忧，尽管有和平协议信号，能源市场仍存在地缘政治风险溢价，黄金在$4,300以下承压交易。

title.zh: 芯片股反弹带动纳斯达克期货，美满电子股价大涨将被纳入标普500
title.en: Chip Stocks Rebound Leads Nasdaq Futures, Marvell Surges to Be Added to S&P 500

summary.en: Monday premarket is anchored by two conflicting themes: a rebound in semiconductor stocks after Friday’s sharp AI-sector selloff, and escalating Middle East tensions lifting oil prices above $95 while spiking Treasury yields near session highs ahead of Wednesday's CPI test.
summary.zh: 周一盘前由两个相互矛盾的主题主导：半导体板块在周五经历巨额抛售后的反弹，以及中东局势紧张推高油价至$95 以上并令美债收益率接近日内高点——周三将公布的关键CPI数据成为市场焦点。

title.zh: 博通营收达标但 AI 指引不变引发半导体疲软
title.en: Broadcom Beats Earnings But AI Guidance Flat Triggers Semiconductor Weakness

summary.en: US stocks face premarket pressure ahead of critical May Non-Farm Payrolls release tonight. Broadcom (AVGO) disappointed AI guidance despite beating estimates, triggering semiconductor sector weakness. Middle East geopolitics continue to drive oil prices and DXY volatility.
summary.zh: 美国 5 月非农就业数据公布前，美股面临盘前压力。博通（AVGO）业绩超出市场预期，但其 AI 业务指引令人失望，拖累半导体板块。中东局势仍在影响油价和美元指数。

title.zh: AI earnings 动量：英伟达 FY2027 第一季度超越预期推动芯片板块反弹
title.en: AI Earnings Momentum: Nvidia Q1 FY2027 Beats Drive Chip Sector Rally

summary.en: Mid-June market focus: AI earnings season continues with Nvidia and big tech driving sector gains; Middle East peace talks extend uncertainty on oil prices; Treasury yields remain stable near 4.5% as inflation expectations anchor amid geopolitical transmission risks.
summary.zh: 六月中旬市场焦点：AI 相关公司的财报季仍在继续，英伟达和大型科技股带动相关板块上涨；中东和平谈判延长油价不确定性；美债收益率稳定在 4.5%附近，通胀预期在地缘政治传导风险下锚定。

title.zh: 美股持平，投资者等待就业数据，AI 板块持续上涨
title.en: US Stocks Hold Flat as Investors Await Jobs Data and AI Sector Continues Rally

summary.en: US futures remain flat after a record-setting session, with SP500 and Dow futures unchanged while Nasdaq 100 futures gain 0.1%. Investors are eyeing jobs data releases and continued AI sector strength as key catalysts. Oil prices rise on supply concerns, while geopolitical tensions over US-Iran negotiations add uncertainty.
summary.zh: 美股期货在创纪录交易后保持平稳，标普 500 期货和道指期货持平，纳斯达克 100 期货上涨 0.1%。投资者关注就业数据发布和持续的 AI 板块强势作为主要催化剂。油价因供应担忧上涨，而美伊谈判的地缘政治紧张局势增加了不确定性。

title.zh: Marvell 因英伟达 CEO 背书股价飙升
title.en: Marvell Technology Soars on Nvidia CEO's Trillion-Dollar Endorsement

summary.en: US futures trade negative amid Middle East peace talks uncertainty, with Marvell Technology surging on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's trillion-dollar endorsement. Markets await US-Iran deal outcomes as oil prices stabilize and AI chip sector remains bullish on production ramp-up and new partnerships.
summary.zh: 美股期指在中东和平谈判不确定性影响下表现偏弱，Marvell Technology 因英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋的万亿估值背书而大涨。市场关注美伊协议进展，油价趋稳，AI 芯片板块在产能扩张和新合作中保持强势。

title.zh: Nvidia 推出新 AI PC 芯片重塑计算，股价上涨 1.6%
title.en: Nvidia Unveils New AI PC Chip to Reinvent Computing, Shares Rise 1.6%

summary.en: US stocks open June with mixed signals as Nvidia's new PC chip announcement and AI momentum lift tech stocks, even as Middle East tensions surge oil prices by 6% and pressure broader equities. Investors focus on Friday's jobs report and Fed chairman Kevin Warsh's debut as inflation concerns from the Iran conflict linger. Pre-market: Dow E-minis +0.28%, S&P 500 E-minis +0.23%, Nasdaq 100 E-minis +0.29%.
summary.zh: 美股周一开盘呈现分歧信号：Nvidia 发布新 PC 芯片提振科技股，但中东紧张局势令油价飙升 6% 压制大盘。投资者关注周五就业数据与美联储主席 Kevin Warsh 亮相，伊朗冲突引发的通胀担忧持续存在。盘前：道指 E 迷你期指 +0.28%，标普 500 E 迷你期指 +0.23%，纳指 100 期指 +0.29%。

title.zh: 美伊和平协议预期提振市场情绪并给油价带来压力
title.en: Potential US-Iran Peace Deal Lifts Market Sentiment and Pressures Oil Prices

summary.en: US futures rise on peace deal hopes amid Middle East tensions easing; AI rally continues but oil slips below $86.50 on Iran truce extension; 10Y treasuries stabilize near 4.48%.
summary.zh: 美股期货上涨，中东和平协议希望升温；AI 板块持续反弹，但油价因伊朗停火协议延长而跌破 86.50 美元；10 年期美债收益率稳定在 4.48% 附近。

title.zh: 中东紧张局势升级：美国对伊朗目标的新一轮打击和以色列在黎巴嫩的空袭提高了地缘政治风险
title.en: Middle East tensions escalate: Renewed U.S. strikes on Iranian targets and Israeli air attacks in Lebanon raise geopolitical risks

summary.en: US futures remain flat to slightly up amid mixed Middle East developments, with Nasdaq extending AI momentum while Dow lags. S&P 500 futures at 7,539 (flat), Nasdaq 30,082 (steady), Dow 50,582 (+0.1%). Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East continue to dominate risk sentiment, while cooling PCE data offers some relief to inflation concerns.
summary.zh: 美国期货在中东局势变化中保持平稳至微涨，纳斯达克延续 AI 动量而道指拖后腿。标普 500 期货 7,539 点（持平），纳斯达克 30,082 点（稳定），道指 50,582 点（+0.1%）。中东地缘政治紧张局势继续主导风险情绪，而放缓的 PCE 数据为通胀担忧提供了一些缓解。

title.zh: 三大指数期货在 AI 乐观和 Middle East 和平希望下上涨
title.en: Major index futures rally on AI optimism and Middle East peace hopes

summary.en: Market sentiment improves with major index futures rising on AI optimism and cautious Middle East peace hopes. Oil eases as geopolitical premium narrows. Treasury yields fall toward multi-week lows. AI chip sector shows resilience despite short-term profit-taking. Energy calms while big tech awaits earnings clarity.
summary.zh: 市场情绪改善，三大指数期货上涨，受益于 AI 乐观和谨慎的中东和平希望。油价回落，地缘溢价收窄。美债收益率降至多周低点附近。尽管有短线获利了结，AI 芯片股仍具韧性。能源板块趋稳，投资者等待大型科技公司财报提供更多线索。

title.zh: 美国股市期货升至纪录高位，AI 乐观情绪超越中东风险
title.en: U.S. Stock Futures Rise to Records as AI Optimism Trumps Middle East Risks

summary.en: U.S. stock index futures rose to record highs on Tuesday as AI-driven optimism in semiconductor stocks offset Middle East geopolitical risks, with S&P 500 E-minis up 0.78% and Nasdaq 100 E-minis gaining 1.16% in premarket trading ahead of the Fed chair's first week.
summary.zh: 周二美股股指期货创历史新高。AI 热潮提振半导体股，抵消了中东地缘风险。盘前标普 500 E-mini 期货涨 0.78%，纳斯达克 100 E-mini 期货涨 1.16%，市场也关注美联储主席上任后的首周。

title.zh: 科技板块轮动持续，投资者寻求价值替代
title.en: Tech sector rotation continues as investors seek value alternatives

summary.en: Markets mixed with sector rotation ongoing. Tech firms monitor AI spending sustainability post-NVDA miss. Oil stabilizes near $104 as geopolitical premium narrows. Treasury yields firm above 4.6% with inflation stickiness concerns. Energy sector leads session as supply constraints outweigh peace dividend.
summary.zh: 市场分化，板块轮动持续。科技公司在 NVDA 不及预期后关注 AI 支出可持续性。油价在地缘溢价收窄后稳定在 104 美元附近。10 年期收益率稳定在 4.6% 以上，通胀顽固担忧犹存。能源板块领跑，供应约束超越和平红利。

title.zh: 英伟达财报不及预期，AI 芯片增长放缓
title.en: Nvidia earnings miss expectations as AI chip growth slows

summary.en: Markets down modestly as Nvidia earnings disappointment overshadows Iran peace deal progress. Oil remains elevated on supply fears despite diplomatic breakthrough. 10Y yields stable near 4.64% as bond vigilance persists.
summary.zh: 市场小幅下跌，英伟达财报不及预期掩盖了伊朗和平协议进展。尽管外交突破，供应担忧使油价维持高位。10 年期收益率稳定在 4.64% 附近，债市谨慎情绪持续。
